comment: Scenarios that cannot pass in fixture mode because of a property of the installed vendor CLI or its protocol, not a regression. See REVIEW.md 'Known Environment Limitations'. Any other failing scenario fails the release gate; an entry here that starts passing also fails the gate and must be removed.
switchComment: Recorded against `batcave conformance --adapter <kind> --fixture` with BATMAN_DISABLE_VENDOR_CLI=1 set, which is how CI runs this gate (see the `test` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml and the `conformance` job in .github/workflows/release.yml, both of which set it). Fixture mode never spawns a vendor CLI under that switch, so every scenario whose only proof is a real vendor process is listed here as an honest skip-shaped failure rather than a fabricated pass. Running fixture mode with the switch unset on a machine that has the vendor CLIs installed will make several of these pass and trip this gate's own rotting-baseline check -- that is expected, not a regression: reconcile against the switch-set run.
